title: Notice to Pensioners: Submission of Life Certificate
report_title: Old Age Pension Scheme — Notice to Pensioners

glance.headline: Submit Life Certificate by 30.11.2026 to continue receiving pension

summary: This is a notice regarding the Old Age Pension Scheme for Smt. Kamala Devi.
Pensioners are required to submit their Life Certificate on or before 30 November 2026.
If the certificate is not submitted, monthly pension payments of Rs. 1,200 will be stopped from December 2026.
You can submit the certificate at your bank branch or a Common Service Centre along with your Aadhaar card and pension book.
spoken_summary: This is a notice from the Social Welfare Officer regarding your old age pension. Smt. Kamala Devi must submit her Life Certificate by 30 November 2026. You can submit it at your pension bank branch or any Common Service Centre. Please take your Aadhaar card and pension book with you. If you do not submit it, your monthly pension of 1,200 rupees will be stopped starting December 2026.

OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT SOCIAL WELFARE OFFICER (SAMPLE)
Old Age Pension Scheme — Notice to Pensioners

Pension ID: OAP/BLR/2019/04417
Monthly pension amount: Rs. 1,200
Name: Smt. Kamala Devi

Pensioners must submit Life Certificate on or before 30.11.2026
Payment will be withheld from December 2026 if not submitted.

The Life Certificate may be submitted at the pension-disbursing bank branch or at any Common Service Centre (CSC). Pensioners must carry their Aadhaar card and pension book. Collect the acknowledgement receipt.

District Social Welfare Officer
